# 2 Chronicles Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was at-end-of twenty years that built Solomon house-of YHWH and-his-house.

**2** And-the-cities that gave Huram to-Solomon Solomon built them and-he-settled there sons-of Israel.

**3** And-he-went Solomon to-Hamath-zobah and-he-prevailed against-it.

**4** And-he-built Tadmor in-the-wilderness and-all cities-of the-storage that he-built in-Hamath.

**5** And-he-built Beth-horon the-upper and Beth-horon the-lower cities-of fortification with-walls gates and-bars.

**6** And-Baalath and-all cities-of the-storage that were for-Solomon and-all cities-of the-chariot and-cities-of the-horsemen and-all desire-of Solomon that he-desired to-build in-Jerusalem and-in-the-Lebanon and-in-all land-of his-dominion.

**7** All the-people the-remaining from the-Hittites and-the-Amorites and-the-Perizzites and-the-Hivites and-the-Jebusites who not were from-Israel

**8** from their-sons who were-left after-them in-the-land whom not consumed sons-of Israel Solomon raised-them for-forced-labor to this day.

**9** And-from sons-of Israel not gave Solomon for-his-work for they were-men-of war and-commanders-of his-officers and-commanders-of his-chariots and-his-horsemen.

**10** And-these were-chiefs-of the-officers that were-for the-king Solomon two-hundred and-fifty the-ruling over-the-people.

**11** And-daughter-of Pharaoh Solomon brought-up from-city-of David to-the-house that he-built for-her for he-said not shall-dwell a-wife of-mine in-house-of David king-of Israel for holy they are the-places-where has-come to-them ark-of YHWH.

**12** Then offered Solomon burnt-offerings to-YHWH on altar-of YHWH that he-built before the-porch

**13** and-according-to-the-matter-of a-day in-its-day to-offer according-to-commandment-of Moses for-the-sabbaths and-for-the-new-moons and-for-the-appointed-feasts three times in-the-year in-feast-of the-unleavened-bread and-in-feast-of the-weeks and-in-feast-of the-booths.

**14** And-he-set according-to-judgment-of David his-father the-divisions-of the-priests over their-service and-the-Levites over their-duties to-praise and-to-serve before the-priests according-to-the-matter-of a-day in-its-day and-the-gatekeepers in-their-divisions to-gate and-gate for so commanded David man-of God.

**15** And-not they-turned-aside from-commandment-of the-king upon the-priests and-the-Levites concerning-any matter and-concerning-the-treasuries.

**16** And-was-prepared all work-of Solomon from the-day the-foundation-of house-of YHWH and-until its-completion complete was house-of YHWH.

**17** Then went Solomon to-Ezion-geber and-to Eloth on shore-of the-sea in-land-of Edom.

**18** And-he-sent to-him Huram by-hand-of his-servants ships and-servants knowing the-sea and-they-came with servants-of Solomon to-Ophir and-they-took from-there four-hundred and-fifty talents-of gold and-they-brought to-the-king Solomon.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **8:2**: cities that gave Huram to-Solomon — In Kings, Solomon gives cities to Hiram; in Chronicles, Huram gives cities to Solomon. The Chronicler reverses the exchange to protect Solomon's reputation.

- **8:11**: holy they are the-places — Solomon's theological awareness: the ark's presence sanctifies space, making it unsuitable for a foreign wife. This is the Chronicler's way of acknowledging the marriage while mitigating its negative implications.

- **8:14**: David man-of God — A title usually reserved for prophets (Moses, Samuel). The Chronicler elevates David to prophetic status in his liturgical legislation.


— EMET
